A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''singer''' was once captured by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Bar-Kooda]] and brought aboard [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Bloodstar]]''. She [[Musician/Legends|sang]] a [[Music/Legends|song]] about a [[binggy]] to Bar-Kooda and his crew of pirates. Despite being saddened by the song, Bar-Kooda [[Death/Legends|shot]] the singer, noting that the pirates would be able to make a fine [[Diet/Legends|supper]] out of her.<ref name="BarKooda">''[[Boba Fett: Bounty on Bar-Kooda]]''</ref>
